models_evaluated: K Health AI clinical decision support

links.outcome: Quality rating of AI recommendations versus treating physician decisions on same visits
links.effect: AI recommendations rated optimal more often (77.1%) than physician decisions (67.1%); quality better for AI in 20.8%, better for physicians in 11.3%, equal in 67.9%.
links.quote: Among the 461 weighted visits, AI recommendations were more frequently rated as optimal (77.1% [95% CI, 72.7% to 80.9%]) compared with treating physician decisions (67.1% [CI, 62.9% to 71.1%]).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of real-world deployed AI-assisted virtual urgent care comparing raw AI recommendations with final clinician-reviewed decisions, assessing the effect of human-in-the-loop oversight.
